title: MEW2SMK's Rose Ringed Parakeets
description: Texture pack which retextures the green parrot to a rose ringed parakeet (ringneck parrot in some regions)
body:
**Texture pack to retexture the boring vanilla green parrot to a ringneck parrot (rose ringed parakeets in some regions).**

I did this because I haven't seen a lot of parrot texture packs online.

_(If there is some bugs with the texture disable the fresh animations texture pack if you have it.)_
